notes: Modified cash basis audit. Governmental: Statement of Revenues Received, Expenditures Paid and Changes in Fund Balances (pp4-5), Total Governmental Funds column. Fund balance roll-forward ties: 665,626 + 900,388 - 1,052,239 + 239,819 - 184,000 + 435,000 = 1,004,594. Cash and fund balance are separate measures: beginning/ending cash are the printed Cash and cash equivalents of the governmental funds statement (2021 comparative 593,105; 2022 801,509, p3), investments separately (98,051 / 248,366). Proceeds of refunding bonds 435,000 (Street Fund) printed under Other Financing Sources -> debt_proceeds (the Statement of Activities lists it as 'Bond proceeds' among general revenues). Sales and miscellaneous taxes = Sales taxes on the Statement of Activities (227,880, p2). Business-type: proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p7), same totals as the Statement of Activities (expenses 483,340, charges 435,154, interest 355, transfers (55,819), net position 2,540,364 -> 2,436,714); other operating revenues 9,625 counted in charges for services per the Statement of Activities. Proprietary cash flows from p8 Total column; capital and related financing prints only a dash (no activity), recorded null. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1), since it carries internal balances and business capital assets that the governmental funds statement does not. Detail: budgetary comparison schedules for every governmental and proprietary fund (pp9-19); zero-actual lines (capital outlay with budget only, Keno other supplies) omitted; Police, Library, Park & Rec, Keno and Garbage print no revenue total line. Capital outlay with function from the fund name (Street, Fire); detail_category not itemized. Transfers: General out 184,000 = Police 46,000 + Fire 20,000 + Library 36,000 + Park & Rec 82,000; Sewer out 55,819 -> Debt Service; Garbage out 10,000 -> Sewer. Read pages 1-19 of 19
